name: Timor-Leste

flag.description: A red field with a black triangle at the hoist laid over a larger yellow triangle (arrowhead), and a white five-pointed star, tilted, in the black triangle.
flag.symbolism: Yellow represents the traces of colonialism, black the obscurantism to be overcome, red the struggle for liberation, and the white star peace and the light that guides the way.

hook: Timor-Leste is a red flag with a black arrowhead on a yellow arrowhead pointing in, and a tilted white star in the black.
trivia: The flag was first used in 1975 when FRETILIN declared independence from Portugal, and was readopted at independence in 2002.
Timor-Leste was the first new sovereign state of the 21st century.
